whats.OpenAI wants to rename its data centres: A naming change like this often signals how a company wants its technology seen, not a change in what it actually does.
whats.Why enterprise AI investments fail to de: Managers should note that many AI rollouts stall when business goals are vague, even with good technology.
whats.Pantera Partner Explains How AI Agents A: This points to AI tools increasingly shaping how software companies sell and get paid, worth watching for budget planning.
whats.SK Telecom grows enterprise-wide AI tran: Large firms expanding company wide AI programmes shows this shift is becoming standard practice, not experimental.
whats.What is Volta-Autodoxer, new AI-enhanced: New AI-powered hacking tools mean managers should treat basic cybersecurity training as urgent, not optional.

term.def: Malicious software that uses AI to study a victim's system and craft custom attacks in seconds, instead of using the same old method for everyone.

prompt.prompt: Write a short staff memo explaining how AI tools can make phishing emails look more convincing, with three quick checks before clicking a link from [a vendor, bank, or client].

quiz.why: This is exactly what the headline states.

quiz.why: This is exactly what the headline states.

quiz.q: AI can genuinely feel emotions the same way people do.
quiz.why: AI can mimic emotional language convincingly but it does not actually feel anything.

quiz.q: Many enterprise AI projects fail because the business problem was unclear from the start, not because the technology was weak.
quiz.why: Unclear goals and poor planning are common, well known reasons AI projects underdeliver.

quiz.q: Adding more automated AI tools to a business always lowers its costs.
quiz.why: New AI tools often bring setup, training and maintenance costs that can outweigh early savings.
